content.text: tinymce is a direct docs dependency, so it's hoisted; lucide isn't. That's the missing piece — docs needs `lucide` as a devDependency so pnpm hoists it into a resolvable location for the renderDir build.
Add `lucide` as a devDependency of docs (catalog-pinned, matching the template's `latest`/pnpm-workspace catalog entry).

content.input: {"command": "vp install 2>&1 | tail -30", "explanation": "Reinstall dependencies so lucide gets hoisted into docs/node_modules", "goal": "Install new lucide dependency for docs package", "mode": "sync"}

content.input: {"command": "cd docs && node scripts/build-canvas-rce.ts 2>&1 | tail -40", "explanation": "Rerun the canvas-rce build to verify the lucide resolution error is fixed", "goal": "Verify build succeeds", "mode": "sync"}

content.text: Build succeeds now (the large-chunk message is just a warning, not an error). The fix: `docs/package.json` was missing `lucide` as a devDependency, so when the `canvas-theme-editor` scaffold template (which imports `lucide` in `main.ts.tmpl`) is rendered into `docs/.vitepress/cache/canvas-rce-src` and built without its own `node_modules`, pnpm's non-flat layout couldn't resolve `lucide` since it wasn't hoisted for any docs-tree package. Added `"lucide": "catalog:"` to `docs/package.json` devDependencies and ran `vp install`.
